description: Authoritative source-backed parameter anchors from the Z1 Phase 3 plan. These values MUST NOT be overwritten or modified.

anchors.rationale: M1 models exactly 3 cohorts: passive_viewers, active_viewers, power_users
constraints: Must be exactly 3 for M1 scope
anchors.notes: Matches z1_m1_rules.md §1: M1 has exactly 3 cohorts

anchors.rationale: 104 weekly epochs = 2 years of simulation horizon

anchors.provenance: Z1 Phase 3 Plan — M1 Adoption Stress Points
anchors.rationale: Four canonical adoption sizes representing key scale thresholds from moderate to massive adoption
constraints: All values must be positive integers
Values must be preserved exactly in all grids

anchors.provenance: Z1 Phase 3 Plan — M1 Claim Rate Stress Points
anchors.rationale: Three canonical claim rates spanning low-to-high extraction pressure
constraints: Values must be preserved exactly in all grids

anchors.provenance: Z1 Phase 3 Plan — M1 Onboarding Profiles
anchors.rationale: Three canonical temporal onboarding profiles controlling user arrival distribution
anchors.notes: Controls when vesting pressure peaks relative to epoch timeline

anchors.provenance: Z1 Phase 3 Plan — M1 Critical Vesting Stress Test
anchors.rationale: Specific stress test: 200M users with a 180-day cliff creating synchronized vesting pressure
constraints: cliff_days=180 is the hard anchor for vesting grid center
anchors.notes: 180 days ≈ 26 weekly epochs; tests worst-case synchronized unlock

anchors.provenance: Z1 Phase 3 Plan — M1 Health Thresholds
anchors.rationale: Maximum acceptable settlement pressure ratio; above this the system is under structural stress
anchors.notes: Used as the primary diagnostic threshold in settlement pressure bands

anchors.provenance: Z1 Phase 3 Plan — M1 Utility Parameters
anchors.rationale: Default share of utility spend captured as protocol fee revenue
anchors.notes: Anchors the utility fee share grid center
